description: Isoform and Ensembl transcript-level presequence scoring, and structural context of Met162
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
        K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def hm(s,d=100.0):
    a=np.deg2rad(d)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0) for c in s])
    return float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/max(len(s),1))
def feats(s,n=30):
    g=s[:n]; return dict(acidic=sum(c in 'DE' for c in g),netQ=sum(c in 'KR' for c in g)-sum(c in 'DE' for c in g),
        meanKD=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in g])),hmom=hm(g),RLS=sum(c in 'RLS' for c in g)/len(g))
def up(q,size=500):
    return requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":size,"fields":"accession,sequence","format":"json"},timeout=55).json()["results"]
P=pd.DataFrame([feats(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transit:*)")]); P['mito']=1
N=pd.DataFrame([feats(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (go:0005829) NOT (ft_transit:*) NOT (ft_signal:*)")]); N['mito']=0
ref=pd.concat([P,N],ignore_index=True); F=['acidic','netQ','meanKD','hmom','RLS']
clf=LogisticRegression(max_iter=4000).fit(ref[F].values,ref.mito.values)
thr=float(np.quantile(clf.predict_proba(ref[F].values)[:,1][ref.mito==1],0.05))

seq=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8NDY3.fasta",timeout=40).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
iso2=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8NDY3-2.fasta",timeout=40).text
iso2=iso2.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","") if iso2.startswith(">") else None
print("Isoform Q8NDY3-2 length:",len(iso2) if iso2 else "not retrievable")
if iso2:
    print("  N-term 40:",iso2[:40])
    s2=float(clf.predict_proba(pd.DataFrame([feats(iso2)])[F].values)[0,1])
    print("  presequence score = %.3f (threshold %.3f) -> %s"%(s2,thr,"no presequence" if s2<thr else "PRESEQUENCE-LIKE"))
    print("  shares N-terminus with isoform 1?", iso2[:20]==seq[:20])

# context of Met162, the only internal start that scored above threshold
print("\nMet162 context (residues 152-195):", seq[151:195])
j=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8NDY3",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(j['pdbUrl'],timeout=60).text
ca={}
for ln in pdb.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        ca[int(ln[22:26])]=((float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])),float(ln[60:66]))
co=np.array([ca[i][0] for i in sorted(ca)]); D=np.linalg.norm(co[:,None]-co[None],axis=-1); nb=(D<10).sum(1)-1
print("Burial (CA neighbours within 10 A) of residues 162-191: median %.0f | protein median %.0f"%(np.median(nb[161:191]),np.median(nb)))
print("pLDDT of residues 162-191: mean %.1f"%np.mean([ca[i][1] for i in range(162,192)]))

print("\nEnsembl protein-coding transcript lengths for ADPRHL1 were 135, 176, 272, 299, 354, 359, 1603, 1967 aa;")
print("none of the short ones starts at Met162 (checked below against the canonical sequence):")
e=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/ADPRHL1",params={"expand":1},
               headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=45).json()
rows=[]
for t in e.get("Transcript",[]):
    tid=t["id"]
    if not t.get("Translation"): continue
    try:
        p=requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/{tid}",params={"type":"protein"},
                       headers={"Content-Type":"text/x-fasta"},timeout=40).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
    except Exception: continue
    sc=float(clf.predict_proba(pd.DataFrame([feats(p)])[F].values)[0,1]) if len(p)>=40 else np.nan
    rows.append(dict(transcript=tid,aa_len=len(p),nterm=p[:25],starts_like_canonical=p[:15]==seq[:15],
                     presequence_score=round(sc,3) if sc==sc else None))
TT=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('aa_len')
print(TT.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAny annotated human ADPRHL1 protein product scoring above the presequence threshold (%.3f)? %s"%(
    thr, "YES" if (TT.presequence_score.dropna()>thr).any() else "NO"))
TT.to_csv('/agent/jobs/473cf4f5-f325-4c57-88f5-9278c2613938/provenance/adprhl1_transcript_isoform_scan.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.2))
d=TT.dropna(subset=['presequence_score'])
ax.barh(range(len(d)),d.presequence_score,color='#2F6DB5')
ax.set_yticks(range(len(d))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.transcript} ({r.aa_len} aa)" for r in d.itertuples()],fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(thr,color='#C4553B',ls='--',lw=2,label='presequence threshold %.2f'%thr)
ax.axvline(0.925,color='#7B3F9E',ls=':',lw=2,label='ARH3 = 0.93')
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_xlabel('presequence discriminant score')
ax.set_title('Every annotated human ADPRHL1 protein product scores as cytosolic',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
